basic.name: 普通攻击：暗渊四重奏
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和冰属性伤害；
招式第四段攻击为射击攻击，射击攻击发动期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，从而发动蓄力射击；
第四段攻击招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to four attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ice DMG.
The fourth attack is a shot. During this attack, hold [Basic Attack] to charge and perform a charged shot.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the fourth attack, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

special.name: 特殊技：魂狩·断罪
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
旋转镰刀后向前方发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
旋转镰刀攻击，随后进行终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为非重击；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Spins the scythe to attack and then executes a powerful Finishing Move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：诡影·斩
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动射击攻击，射击攻击期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，从而发动蓄力射击；
发动射击攻击视为发动一次普通攻击，伤害视为普通攻击伤害；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式射击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%;
招式斩击期间与射击后撤期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
During the skill, hold [Basic Attack] to launch a shot. During the shot, hold [Basic Attack] to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.

chain.name: 连携技：命运戏法
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:

Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive Ice DMG.
The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot.

facts.text:
[连携技：命运戏法]命中敌人或雨果的攻击使敌人失衡时，雨果获得[暗渊回响]状态，持续6秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，该状态下雨果的暴击率提升12%，暴击伤害提升25%；
队伍中存在其他1/2名[击破]角色时，雨果的攻击力提升300/900点；
[强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒]或[终结技：渎神者]的终结一击命中敌人时，若敌人处于失衡状态，会对其触发[决算]效果，使得招式的终结一击伤害倍率提升1000%，此外[决算]效果会根据触发时敌人剩余的失衡时间，使得该招式伤害倍率进一步提升：敌人失衡时间小于等于5秒的部分，每剩余1秒，招式伤害倍率提升280%，5秒到15秒的部分，每剩余1秒，招式伤害倍率提升100%，总共最多可以提升3400%的招式伤害倍率；
雨果触发[决算]效果后，敌人的失衡状态会立即结束，并且根据[决算]效果触发时该敌人剩余的失衡时间立即累积一定失衡值，失衡时间每剩余1秒，则积累5%失衡值，最多累积等同于敌人失衡值上限25%的失衡值；
[强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒]命中敌人时，若敌人处于非失衡状态，招式累积的失衡值提升20%。
facts.textEn:
When Chain Attack: Trick of Fate hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the Dark Abyss Reverb state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 Stun characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by 300/900.
When the Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment or Ultimate: Blaspheme hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the Totalize effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by 1,000%. Additionally, the Totalize effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 280%; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 100%. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of 3,400%.
After Hugo triggers the Totalize effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment Totalize is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

cinema.name: 仇恨之子
cinema.description: [暗渊回响]状态下，触发[决算]效果时招式的暴击率额外提升12%，暴击伤害额外提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When triggering the Totalize effect in the Dark Abyss Reverb state, the skill's CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 12%, and CRIT DMG by 30%.

cinema.name: 内在小孩

cinema.descriptionEn: When Ultimate: Blaspheme triggers Totalize, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when Totalize is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.

cinema.descriptionEn: After a Charged Shot hits an enemy, Hugo's attacks against that target will ignore 12% of that target's Ice RES for 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.description: 所有射击攻击命中敌人时，均可触发[暗渊回响]状态，最多持续6秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；此外，任意招式触发[决算]效果时，此次伤害额外提升60%；[强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒]的终结一击命中非失衡状态下的敌人时也可触发[决算]效果，使得招式的终结一击伤害倍率固定提升1000%。

The Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment also triggers the Totalize effect when hitting an enemy that isn't Stunned, boosting the DMG multiplier of the Finishing Move by a fixed 1,000 %.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：诡影·破
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进攻击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：魂狩·断罪
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
旋转镰刀后向前方发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：魂狩·惩戒
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
旋转镰刀攻击，随后进行终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为非重击；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Spins the scythe to attack and then executes a powerful Finishing Move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：渎神者
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出镰刀对前方敌人发动强力旋转攻击，随后进行终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为非重击；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Throws the scythe in a powerful spinning attack, then launches a Finishing Move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：葬歌
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动射击攻击，射击攻击期间长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，从而发动蓄力射击；
发动射击攻击视为发动一次普通攻击，伤害视为普通攻击伤害；
招式发动后可直接衔接[普通攻击：暗渊四重奏]的第四段攻击；
招式射击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%;
招式斩击期间与射击后撤期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
During the skill, hold [Basic Attack] to launch a shot. During the shot, hold [Basic Attack] to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.
